result:
The WRK-SPEC is written, validated, gate-A1-reviewed, and committed as `b7a806f`. Stopping here as instructed — `status` remains `draft`, not transitioned to `active`, and `writing-plans` was not invoked.

Summary: `specs/work/WRK-SPEC-BILL-STATEMENT-001-monthly-statement-module.md` specs a `src/statement.js` module (`generateMonthlyStatements(customers, year, month)`) built entirely on `round2`/`prorata` from `src/billing.js`, activating DOM-BILL-PRORATA-001. Gate A1 surfaced real issues that got fixed into the spec: a floating-point half-up rounding bug already present in `billing.js` (documented as an inherited limitation, not silently fixed), a timezone bug in naive `Date`-based day parsing (resolved by mandating string-slice parsing), an undefined `month` base (now 1-based), an under-specified AC set that a stub could trivially satisfy (tightened), and a fabricated FRAG commit anchor (re-cited against current HEAD). Three Knowledge gaps are recorded for future domain work: the "mid-cycle" definition, `billing.js`'s rounding tie-boundary limitation, and calendar-timezone ownership.
